models.name: DeepSeek-V3-class MoE (671B/37B)
models.note: Published architecture; at ~6 bit/weight the checkpoint is ~500 GB, the 'hypothetical 500 GB DeepSeek'.

models.name: Dense 500B (hypothetical)
models.note: Hypothetical dense model, 120 layers, GQA 8 KV heads x 128; every weight is read for every token.

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B (today's Continuum model)
models.note: Effective ~4B per token per the 'E4B' naming; exact layer data not verified here (UNKNOWN).

devices.name: Galaxy Z Fold7 alone
devices.sources: 12/16 GB LPDDR5X (spec sheets), 84.8 GB/s peak -> ~50 effective; UFS 4.0 ~4.2 GB/s peak -> ~3 effective for large blocks; ~2 TFLOP/s effective FP16-class on CPU/GPU is an assumption; watts are assumptions to be replaced by Fold7 measurements.

devices.name: Fold7 + PC over USB 3.2 Gen 2
devices.sources: Phone computes, PC serves weights over ~1 GB/s effective USB link (10 Gbit/s raw).

devices.name: Own PC (64 GB RAM, PCIe 4 NVMe)
devices.sources: DDR5 dual channel ~60 GB/s effective, NVMe PCIe 4.0 ~7 GB/s peak -> 5; ~20 TFLOP/s effective is an assumption for a mid-range GPU/CPU mix; 120 W compute is an assumption.
